title: BL4ZE.REWARD — Thank You & Major Website Update
message:
Hello,

We’re pleased to share a major update to BL4ZE.REWARD, and we would like to sincerely thank you for being part of our community.

Your support and continued interest help us improve the platform and build a better experience for everyone.

What’s new?

A redesigned experience
We’ve improved the overall design, colors, buttons, navigation and responsiveness across both mobile and PC.

A new icon system
The interface now features a more consistent and modern icon system, with cleaner Lucide-style icons throughout the platform.

More languages
English remains the main language, and we’ve added:

• Français
• Español
• Русский

New “New” category
Websites added within the last 7 days can now be found in the dedicated New category and are marked with a New tag.

Improved website URLs
Website pages now use cleaner and more recognizable slugs.

For example:

"/site/Earnitz"

instead of a long random ID.

New Discord notifications
We’ve also introduced our new @Bl4ze Reward Discord bot, which will automatically post website notifications every day at 11:30 AM French time.

Thank you

Thank you for supporting BL4ZE.REWARD and for being part of this growing community.

This update is only one step in our ongoing development. More improvements, new platforms and features are already planned.

Visit BL4ZE.REWARD:
https://bl4ze-rewards.base44.app

Thank you for being with us.

The BL4ZE.REWARD Team
